test_title: PYST 3: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, A, B, C, D, E, and F are seated in a row facing north. There are exactly two seats to the left of B. F is an immediate neighbour of both B and D. E is not at either of the extreme seats of the row. A is sitting at the leftmost end. C is not an immediate neighbour of E. If A and D decide to swap their positions, what will be the new position of A?

options.text: Third to the right of E
Second to the left of F

solution:
Six friends, A, B, C, D, E, and F are seated in a row facing north.

 
• There are exactly two seats to the left of B.
 
• F is an immediate neighbour of both B and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/770601149591f387ef6eb76122167c2c4785f90fbc6c365d7e0499effe663f37.png] 

**OR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43a69898a6b1427cf2c17a72b292a4ed1f24606c7ff0f30385e901ff5205e084.png] 

 
• E is not at either of the extreme seats of the row.
 
• C is not an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b835fd1345d4572871ed104901a8ef697ebd1960818d4ea5135f75c1b4c3cb7b.png] 

**OR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c54f02b078ddece576b40d7bcfc84cd556612e0832d06fa2560941b3bcdbb7c0.png] 

According to given information exact position of E is not given and C will not sit with E. A is sitting at the leftmost end. So, the first arrangement is rejected.

Now, We will go with the second arrangement.

**So, the final arrangement will be,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c54f02b078ddece576b40d7bcfc84cd556612e0832d06fa2560941b3bcdbb7c0.png] 

According to the condition, A and D decide to swap their positions then it will become:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582a1ba19199dfb50abc322a52b738627244ae6d9678c2f1097d2b08230a7974.png] 

The new position of A will be **Third to the right of E.**

Hence, the** correct answer** is** "Third to the right of E".**
